propositions: The audit page renderer at page.py:329 currently flags criteria as lacking only when kind == "operator-attested" and met is false, but must also accept kind == "non-codebase" to avoid silent failures on immutable historical records.
827 existing COMPLETION_VERDICT events in the live store carry kind: "operator-attested" which are immutable and must be readable before S5 changes the verifier output format.
The lacking flag computation is the only site in the codebase that compares criterion kind against a string literal, and kind is an unconstrained string type with no enum validation.
Rendering logic must accept both "operator-attested" and "non-codebase" kinds as flagging criteria as lacking when met is false, while leaving "codebase-verifiable" criteria unaffected.
